title: Director, Fan Services
People Operations Lead
description:
📍 London - Hybrid. 2 days per week in our London office, 3 days remote / work from home (40 hour week)
🚆 Monthly travel to one of our other offices (Sheffield/Lincoln) is essential.
✴ All travel and accommodation costs to non-base office locations are fully covered.

We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next!

About the role

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.

This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's genuinely curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.

You'll inherit a strong foundation. Over the last three years we've streamlined manual processes, invested in our People technology and changed the way our People function operates. There's plenty we're proud of - but we're definitely not done!

You'll own our People operations, systems and data infrastructure across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle, making sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for opportunities to simplify, automate and improve them.

You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting. You'll work closely with our People Partners, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech teams, so this is a highly collaborative role with influence across Goodlord.

And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us?

We're already exploring how AI and agentic workflows can remove repetitive work across areas such as onboarding, colleague queries, document management, data validation and reporting. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be excited about the possibilities, willing to experiment and comfortable helping us work out where technology can genuinely make things better.

If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you.

Who are you

You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently.

title: UX/UI Designer | Intch
description:
About Intch

Intch is a professional social network with a marketplace for part time work. You can think of it as a professional network built for senior specialists who take on meaningful contracts alongside their main work. A typical contract lasts from three to six months.

The product is used in 140 countries and is available in up to 20 languages. Intch has fewer than 40 people and four product areas, with three already live and one preparing to launch.

Intch is rethinking how people and companies find each other and build trust online. Changes that made the interface feel more like a real conversation have already improved key metrics by up to three times.

About the role

Today one part time designer supports all Intch products. Since the company moved to a product based structure, that is no longer enough. Intch is now looking for its first full time designer.

Product managers build and test early prototypes themselves. Around one in ten experiments moves forward. Your role is to join the thinking early, work through the problem with the product team and turn validated ideas into clear, production ready experiences.

This is a hands on role with broad ownership. You will work across all Intch products and collaborate closely with product managers, engineers and the current designer.

What you will work on

  • Join product discussions early and help shape the problem before screens are made.

  • Take a task from an open question to a production ready design.

  • Design flows where the interface supports communication between people and businesses.

  • Work on onboarding, profiles, discovery, paywalls and other core product areas.

  • Cover key states, edge cases and handoff details, then stay involved during implementation.

  • Extend the existing UI kit and keep patterns consistent across products.

  • Increase the share of design work that can move into production without another rework round.

What matters for this role

  • Strong UI craft and a portfolio of clear, thoughtful interfaces.

  • Solid web product experience. Web is the primary platform at Intch.

  • The ability to explain your decisions through user context, not personal taste.

  • Openness to evidence and the confidence to change

title: Werkstudent Projektkoordination Wohnungswirtschaft NE3 (m/w/d)
description:
Was diesen Job so besonders macht?

Was diesen Job so besonders macht?

  • Du unterstützt unser Projektmanagement im Bereich Wohnungswirtschaft (WoWi) auf der Netzebene 3 (NE3) bei der Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung verschiedener strategischer und operativer Maßnahmen im Glasfaserausbau.
  • Du übernimmst eigene (Teil-)Projekte und begleitest diese von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung – inklusive aktiver Mitarbeit und Mitgestaltung.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Projektleiter:innen, externen Stakeholdern (z.B. Wohnungsunternehmen, Dienstleister, Agenturen) sowie internen Fachbereichen zusammen und koordinierst deren Zusammenarbeit.
  • Du erstellst und pflegst Projekt- und Excel-Reports, übernimmst das Projekt-Tracking und bereitest Ergebnisse übersichtlich und adressatengerecht auf.
  • Du planst und pflegst Bauzeichnungen und Übersichten (z.B. für NE3-Projekte in der Wohnungswirtschaft) und stellst sicher, dass Informationen in den relevanten Systemen und Dateien aktuell und vollständig sind.
  • Du fasst verschiedene Datenquellen und Listen zusammen, strukturierst sie in Excel und leitest daraus aussagekräftige Reportings und Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
  • Du übernimmst Aufgaben in der Dokumentenablage und -pflege (z.B. Projektunterlagen, Verträge, technische Dokumentation) und unterstützt beim Aufbau effizienter Ablagestrukturen.
  • Du unterstützt bei Kommunikation, Trainings und Schulungen für interne Teams und externe Partner – insbesondere im Hinblick auf Prozesse und Tools im Bereich WoWi NE3.
Einiges davon ist neu für Dich?
Kein Ding. Bei OXG haben wir eine offene und innovative Arbeitsatmosphäre, wo Du Raum hast, Ownership zu übernehmen und neue Dinge auszuprobieren.


Wann passt Du zu uns?

  • Du bist aktuell immatrikuliert und studierst idealerweise Wirtschafts-, Sozial-, oder Geisteswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Bauingenieurwesen oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang. 
  • Du bringst erste Praxiserfahrung mit, z.B. durch Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten, und hast Interesse am Thema (agilen) Projektmanagement sowie an der Wohnungswirtschaft und/oder dem Glasfaserausbau.
  • Du besitzt sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit Formeln und Funktionen, Erfahrung mit Pivot-Tabellen und Auswertungen, Freude daran, komplexe Tabellen und Reports zu erstellen, zu pflegen und zu optimieren
  • Du verfügst über starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, arbeitest strukturiert und sorgfältig und bringst ein hohes Maß an Selbstständigkeit mit.

title: Werkstudent Einkauf für Tiefbau- und Planungsleistungen im Glasfaserausbau (m/w/d)
description:
Was diesen Job so besonders macht?

Du möchtest bereits während deines Studiums praktische Erfahrungen sammeln und an anspruchsvollen Infrastrukturprojekten mitwirken? Dann unterstütze unser Einkaufsteam bei der Beschaffung von Tiefbau- und Planungsleistungen für den Glasfaserausbau. Je nach deinen Interessen, Kenntnissen und Fähigkeiten haben wir Aufgaben in operativen und/oder strategischen Einkaufbereichen. Gemeinsam finden wir Aufgaben, die zu dir passen und dir die Möglichkeit geben, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln:

  • Du tauchst direkt ein in den operativen und strategischen Einkauf für Glasfaserausbauprojekte. Von der Beschaffung von Tiefbau- und Planungsleistungen bis zur Bestellabwicklung und Dokumentation. So lernst du echte Praxis statt nur Theorie.
  • Du bist aktiv in Ausschreibungsprozessen eingebunden: Du bereitest Unterlagen vor, holst Angebote ein, prüfst und vergleichst sie und wirkst bei Vergabeentscheidungen sowie der Vorbereitung von Preis- und Vertragsverhandlungen mit.
  • Du erhältst einen tiefen Einblick in den Markt: Du recherchierst zu Preisen, Lieferanten und Angeboten, pflegst Einkaufs-, Lieferanten- und Vertragsdaten und erstellst Auswertungen und Präsentationen, um dein analytisches Denken zu schärfen.
  • Du arbeitest mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen wie Technik, Planung, Projektmanagement und Controlling zusammen und gestaltest aktiv die Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung unserer Einkaufsprozesse mit, so lernst du das Zusammenspiel im Unternehmen kennen.

Wann passt Du zu uns?

  • Du bist immatrikuliert und studierst idealerweise Wirtschaftswissenschaften, BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsrecht oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und hast Interesse am Einkauf für Tiefbau- und Planungsleistungen.

  • Professionelles Auftreten, Empathie und Kommunikationsstärke
  • Erfahrung im digitalen Coaching oder Offenheit für Online-FormateBereitschaft zur Zusammenarbeit auf freiberuflicher Basis

Benefits

  • Du erhältst Zugang zu unserer modernen Videoplattform. ohne zusätzliche Tools
  • Du bist Teil einer wachsenden, professionellen Coaching-Community
  • Du behältst volle Gestaltungsfreiheit über dein Angebot und deine Preise
  • Wir übernehmen für dich Marketing, Sichtbarkeit und Klientenakquise
  • Einfache Abwicklung und transparente Struktur. Du konzentrierst dich auf das, was zählt: deine Coachings

Es handelt sich um eine freiberufliche Tätigkeit – keine Festanstellung und Du entscheidest, wann, wie oft und in welchem Umfang du Coachings anbietest

title: UX/UI Designer | Intch
description:
About Intch

Intch is a professional social network with a marketplace for part time work. You can think of it as a professional network built for senior specialists who take on meaningful contracts alongside their main work. A typical contract lasts from three to six months.

The product is used in 140 countries and is available in up to 20 languages. Intch has fewer than 40 people and four product areas, with three already live and one preparing to launch.

Intch is rethinking how people and companies find each other and build trust online. Changes that made the interface feel more like a real conversation have already improved key metrics by up to three times.

About the role

Today one part time designer supports all Intch products. Since the company moved to a product based structure, that is no longer enough. Intch is now looking for its first full time designer.

Product managers build and test early prototypes themselves. Around one in ten experiments moves forward. Your role is to join the thinking early, work through the problem with the product team and turn validated ideas into clear, production ready experiences.

This is a hands on role with broad ownership. You will work across all Intch products and collaborate closely with product managers, engineers and the current designer.

What you will work on

  • Join product discussions early and help shape the problem before screens are made.

  • Take a task from an open question to a production ready design.

  • Design flows where the interface supports communication between people and businesses.

  • Work on onboarding, profiles, discovery, paywalls and other core product areas.

  • Cover key states, edge cases and handoff details, then stay involved during implementation.

  • Extend the existing UI kit and keep patterns consistent across products.

  • Increase the share of design work that can move into production without another rework round.

What matters for this role

  • Strong UI craft and a portfolio of clear, thoughtful interfaces.

  • Solid web product experience. Web is the primary platform at Intch.

  • The ability to explain your decisions through user context, not personal taste.

  • Openness to evidence and the confidence to change

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

title: Mitarbeiter Vertrieb (m/w/d) landwirtschaftliche Software für mehrere Regionen in Deutschland
description:
Die geo-konzept GmbH (ein Partnerunternehmen der Wimex Group) steht bereits seit 1992 für zuverlässige und robuste Sensorik, GPS- und GIS-Technologien für die Agrar- und Forstwirtschaft sowie die Steinindustrie. Das Unternehmen zählt zu den Marktführern im Bereich der präzisen Landwirtschaft. Dabei stehen besonders Lenk-, Sensor-, Drohnen- und digitale Managementsysteme im Vordergrund. Ziel ist es, dem Kunden durch Komponenten, Sensorik, Automation und auch durch die Integration von Autonomie/Robotik die Arbeit zu erleichtern und umfassende Komplettlösungen an die Hand zu geben. Hierbei stehen der praktische Nutzen sowie die Betreuung im Vordergrund. Dies wird mit Fachwissen und Erfahrung - auch über die Grenzen der eigenen Produkte hinaus - umgesetzt.

Um weiterhin schnell und kundennah im Markt agieren zu können, suchen wir ab sofort einen Mitarbeiter Vertrieb (m/w/d) landwirtschaftliche Software für mehrere Regionen in Deutschland.

Ihre Aufgaben:

  • Für Landwirte, Lohnunternehmer und Händler sind Sie der erste Ansprechpartner

  • Sie akquirieren aktiv neue Kunden und geben Interessenten eine bedarfsspezifische Beratung und schließen einen Auftrag ab

  • Darüber hinaus begleiten Sie die Kunden beim Ersteinsatz unserer Systeme, einschließlich einer ersten Anwendungsschulung

  • Zu unseren bestehenden Kunden pflegen Sie den Kontakt und begeistern diese für weiterführende digitale Lösungen

  • Kundenfeedback geben Sie an die internen Ansprechpartner weiter, um eine schnelle Reaktion und Weiterentwicklung sicherzustellen

  • Sie führen Produktpräsentationen bei Veranstaltungen oder Messen durch


Das sollten sie mitbringen:

  • Sie haben Freude am aktiven Vertrieb sowie am Umgang mit Kunden und bringen eine hohe Serviceorientierung mit

  • Sie interessieren sich für zukunftsweisende, moderne Software (u. a. Farmmanagement, GIS) sowie deren Anwendung und wollen andere dafür begeistern

  • Eine Berufsausbildung oder Studium im landwirtschaftlichen/technischen Bereich sind von Vorteil

  • Sie kennen sich in der Struktur des Landtechnikhandels aus und sind vertraut mit den Herstellern von Saatgut, Pflanzenschutz- und Düngemittel

  • Für eine anwendungsspezifische Beratung sollten Sie Wissen zum Arbeitszyklus im Landbau, der eingesetzten Technik und der Agronomie mitbringen

  • Darüber hinaus besitzen Sie eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und gute Kenntnisse in gängiger Bürosoftware

Wir bieten:

  • Einen sicheren, unbefristeten Arbeitsplatz

  • Arbeit in einem motivierten Team mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und mit viel Begeisterung

title: Senior Rollout Manager (f/m/x) – DACH
description:
Your mission

title: UX/UI Designer | Intch

About Intch

Intch is a professional social network with a marketplace for part time work. You can think of it as a professional network built for senior specialists who take on meaningful contracts alongside their main work. A typical contract lasts from three to six months.

The product is used in 140 countries and is available in up to 20 languages. Intch has fewer than 40 people and four product areas, with three already live and one preparing to launch.

Intch is rethinking how people and companies find each other and build trust online. Changes that made the interface feel more like a real conversation have already improved key metrics by up to three times.

About the role

Today one part time designer supports all Intch products. Since the company moved to a product based structure, that is no longer enough. Intch is now looking for its first full time designer.

Product managers build and test early prototypes themselves. Around one in ten experiments moves forward. Your role is to join the thinking early, work through the problem with the product team and turn validated ideas into clear, production ready experiences.

This is a hands on role with broad ownership. You will work across all Intch products and collaborate closely with product managers, engineers and the current designer.

  • Work on onboarding, profiles, discovery, paywalls and other core product areas.

  • Cover key states, edge cases and handoff details, then stay involved during implementation.

title: Senior Producer
description:
Senior Producer

ScapeWorld Entertainment

Remote. Our working day runs on CET, wherever you sit. Full time, on a long-term contract. Starting as soon as you can. Where you live while you do is up to you; the location field on this posting only fits one country, so please read this as the real rule and apply from wherever you are.

About us

We are Scape, a Swedish game studio of about 30 people, fully remote by choice. We are launching Scape on Steam Early Access later this year: a growing platform of multiplayer games where a player's identity carries across all of them. The first game inside Scape is Gravity: a precision climbing game where 100 players share one server, one tower, and one long way down. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios, Epic and Ubisoft.

Since we are a small team about to put our first game in front of players, we are looking for the person who holds the plan, the priorities and the team together while we do it. If that sounds like you, we would love to meet.

The role

Let us start with the studio you would be joining. Around thirty people, fully remote, and a group of strong leads in design, art, engineering, QA, community and commercial who own their crafts and run their own teams. What we do not have is the person who looks across all of them at once, holds the plan they are all working to, and makes the day-to-day calls that keep it moving as one. That is this role. It is the only production seat in the company, and it comes with real authority.

You would work closely with the Creative Director. They own what the game is, set the direction and make the big bets. You own the plan that gets us there and the decisions inside it: scope, sequencing and trade-offs within a milestone are yours to make, and you decide which questions need to reach them and which do not. They should be able to step back and know that things are being handled, because they are.

In practice, it comes down to four things:

You know how a game gets made. You can see what depends on what, where the effort really sits, and whether an estimate is going to hold. When a lead tells you how long something takes, you know how to hear it and what has to land for the work to ship on time.

You own the plan and the priorities. Not just the schedule, but the order of work behind it. When two things compete, you decide, or you get the decision made and tell everyone affected. Open questions have an owner and a date. Nothing sits unanswered because nobody was sure whose call it was.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (all genders)
description:
What you can expect from us

Eraneos supports AI initiatives from strategy all the way through to production. In most AI projects, there's a gap between the strategy and what actually ends up running in production and creating real value. That's exactly the gap we close.

Who you are

  • You build hands-on, at the highest level — and you think beyond the code.

title: Assessment Delivery Optimisation
description:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health.

 

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

About the role

As Scarlet's first Assessment Delivery Optimisation hire, you will own how Scarlet plans, prioritises and deploys assessment resources across our whole customer portfolio. You will build the operating model for a fast-growing portfolio: in twelve months’ time, we expect to serve roughly four times today's customer base — assessing all types of devices, across a range of regulatory frameworks and standards.

You will solve a complex global scheduling problem. Our assessment experts are distributed around the world, many work part-time or as contractors, and some customer assessments must happen in person. You will build systems that match each assessment with the right expertise, location and timing.

You will combine operational judgement, data modelling and AI to build planning and deployment systems that keep every assessment moving, from demand forecasting to real-time prioritisation across the portfolio. Your work will determine how quickly safe medical devices reach the patients who need them.

Responsibilities

  • Own portfolio-level capacity planning: forecast how much assessment resource, and of what type, we will need at a given time to meet demand, to ensure hiring and onboarding plans are aligned with capacity needs.

  • Design and optimise how assessment experts are allocated to work, including who performs each activity and when it can begin.

  • Own and improve the scheduling and prioritisation tools used to track evaluator availability, customer availability and qualification status across certification regimes.

  • Partner with product, engineering and machine learning teams to build tools that support automation of large-scale assessment operations.

title: Senior/Staff Product Designer | JetBrains
description:
About JetBrains Air

JetBrains has been building developer tools since 2000 — including IntelliJ IDEA, Kotlin, TeamCity, and more, now trusted by 15M+ developers at 287K companies worldwide. The company is 100% private, profitable, and driven by a single thesis: great tools make developers better.

Air is what JetBrains is building next: an agentic development environment where multiple AI agents run tasks in parallel while the developer stays in control. It’s a genuinely new kind of developer tool — spanning a native desktop app, an expanding web experience, and cloud-based automations. It’s the next frontier after IDEs: not just helping developers write code, but helping them orchestrate it.

The Air design team is two people now — and you’d be the third. Your primary focus will be the web surface and the automations sub-team: an emerging part of the product that is ready for dedicated design ownership, with a real opportunity to raise the bar and shape the experience from the ground up.

What you’ll be working on

  • Design the web interface for Air: team management, automation setup, and a results overview

  • Shape the design process for the automations sub-team, working directly with developers to establish review and handoff practices

  • Take features from ambiguous briefs to shipped interfaces

  • Contribute to the shared design system: add and maintain components in Figma as the product grows

  • Vibe-code and use AI for prototyping when it helps move ideas forward faster

  • Participate in cross-team demos and quarterly planning, bringing a design perspective to where Air should go next

What you need

  • 5+ years of product design experience, with great examples of delivering results that impact the business.

  • Ownership instinct. You see features through from design to production. Delivery is part of your definition of done.

  • Excellent cross-team project delivery. You can work with limited context, clarify what matters, define the scope, and move projects forward across teams without needing constant hand-holding.

  • Active AI user. You use AI tools in your design workflow. You’ve experimented with building or prototyping with Cursor, Claude, or similar. This market moves weekly; you should too.

description:
Are you an experienced railway professional with knowledge and experience of roles like COSS, ES and PICOP?

You already understand the track and the people who work on it. We're looking for people like you to help put new safety technology into the hands of the workforce - and to be part of a big change in how track workers are kept safe.

At Tended, we create first-of-a-kind safety systems that transform rail worker safety. Our geofencing solution has been named one of TIME's Best Inventions and has made the Digital Leaders 100 list for Geospatial Initiative of the Year. It's already out there on the track, helping to keep people away from the running line and improving on site efficiency.

Network Rail is committed to geofencing for the long term, and the rollout across the Sussex region is already underway. We're looking for an Implementation Lead to help us grow our capability on the ground.

Tasks

As an Implementation Lead, you're the bridge between Tended and our clients, guiding their teams through helping their teams get comfortable using our kit out on-site.

You'll lead key client deployments on the ground, working closely with Tended's project managers to deliver an excellent service. Success in this role depends on building strong, trusting relationships quickly - so first-class communication and interpersonal skills are essential.

Our technology is used by track workers with a wide range of technical confidence. You'll develop a deep understanding of our products so you can coach users through their day-to-day challenges and until they’re confident using it on their own. Being on-site also puts you in a unique position to see how our products are really used - spotting ideas for how we can make it better and feeding improvements back to the team.

You'll need strong knowledge of the rail environment and the roles within it, and you'll either hold a Personal Track Safety (PTS) qualification or meet the requirements to obtain one. Above all, we're looking for someone proactive and approachable - person fit matters to us.**

Travel and working pattern

This is a field-based role centred on regular client site visits across the Sussex region. You'll spend at least 3 days a week in the depot and on site, with the remaining time working remotely or in person with your line manager.

Because our users work shifts, this role covers both nightshifts and dayshifts, and includes weekend and bank holiday working - flexibility to meet the needs of the business and our clients is essential.

In return, we have excellent policies covering travel, accommodation and subsistence expenses, as well as fatigue management and time off in lieu.

A full driving licence is required.

What holds them back is the doing: positioning is fuzzy, the right angle is hard to find, time is scarce, and staying consistent over months is harder still. Closing that gap – building the go-to-market foundation and turning a busy expert's knowledge into content that actually moves their business – is what you'll do.

As a B2B Growth Marketer, you'll own part of the growth motion for a portfolio of clients: from go-to-market strategy and positioning, to a running LinkedIn engine, to the content itself. Think of it as several jobs in one: strategist, sharp copywriter, organized project manager, and trusted customer-success partner. You'll sit close to founders and executives, pull the expertise out of their heads, and turn it into positioning, systems, and content that sound unmistakably like them and earn them the right attention.

And yes – you essentially get paid to learn from successful founders and executives every week.

Tasks

Here's what owning that looks like day to day:

Go-To-Market, Positioning & Messaging Setup

Open every engagement by building the foundation for a successful go-to-market motion:

  • Segment the client's market and define their Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) – the targeting framework that guides all go-to-market activities.
  • Develop a positioning & messaging strategy that makes the client easy to remember and easy to buy.
  • Create internal and external alignment on the strategy, delivered as a GTM activities & strategy alignment document, a market segmentation & ICP definition, and a positioning & messaging framework.

LinkedIn Go-To-Market Engine

Set up the strategy and infrastructure for a best-in-class, people-led LinkedIn motion that grows authority, builds trust and education with the audience, and attracts inbound opportunities:

  • Build a bespoke LinkedIn content strategy that ties the LinkedIn motion to business goals – with a strong content narrative, thought-leadership positioning, and clear content pillars that ensure consistency and relevance.
  • Stand up a structured content operations system covering content creation, approval, distribution, and repurposing.
  • Optimize LinkedIn profiles so they build trust and convert visitors.
  • Automate LinkedIn ICP network expansion as well as the capturing, enrichment, and connecting of profile engagers.
  • Set up and manage LinkedIn Thought Leader Ads to amplify the best-performing content directly to the client's ICP – extending reach and demand beyond the organic network.

The Content Engine

  • Run bi-weekly content calls to draw out each client's expertise, stories, and point of view as raw input for ideas.</

title: Backend Developer (Rust)
description:
Rust Engineer — Distributed Execution Engine

Berlin (hybrid) or Remote (countries within ~4–5 hours travel of Berlin)

Our client is a B2B sourcing platform serving the automotive dealership industry. You'll join a small engineering team building the client's sourcing platform. Your focus will be their flowgraph — a horizontally scalable, step-based execution engine, similar in spirit to n8n or Unreal Engine's Blueprints, but built from the ground up in Rust with strong typing and production workloads in mind. title: Engineering Manager
description:
🏆 What's the opportunity?

Air freight carries less than 1% of world trade by volume and more than a third of it by value, around $22.7 billion of goods every single day. It's how a vaccine reaches a clinic before it spoils, how a semiconductor arrives before the production line stops, and how a retailer restocks a continent away in three days instead of five weeks. When speed is the whole point, freight flies.

Somebody has to price it, book it and move it, and that work is still done largely by hand, in inboxes and spreadsheets.

For eight years we've been building the data infrastructure underneath it: direct integrations with 75 airlines, the top ten ocean carriers and dozens of GSAs, used every day by 30,000 freight forwarders across 172 countries to hold their rates, price their business and book their freight.

In 2026 we acquired Cargofive, and cargo.one now spans air and ocean, the two modes that carry international trade. That foundation is what makes the next part possible.

In March 2026 we launched the industry's first AI-native operating system for multimodal freight:one workspace where freight teams and AI agents work side by side across rate management, procurement, quoting, booking and support. Crane Worldwide and Yusen Logistics are rolling it out across their global operations.

AI-led engineering is how we build. Engineers write specs and acceptance criteria, agents do much of the implementation, and the engineer owns the architecture, the review and what ships.

We're backed by Index Ventures, Bessemer, Creandum, Point Nine, Next47 and Lufthansa Cargo, which has been an investor in us since 2018.

🚀 What makes this role different

This is an engineering management job for a team where agents do much of the implementation. That changes the job.

When producing code gets cheaper and faster, the bottleneck moves. Throughput depends more on how well engineers define the problem, direct the agents, review what comes back and tell a plausible answer from a correct one.

You'll lead our engineers: what they ship, how good it is, how fast they move, whether the people are growing, and how quickly the team gets better at working AI-led. A lot of what engineering managers know about pacing, estimating, reviewing and measuring a team was calibrated for a different bottleneck. Working out what good looks like now is part of this job.

title: Technical Recruiter
Claims Handler – Gadget & Warranty
description:
Turning risk into opportunity

Human progress runs on a single trade: risk for opportunity. Every venture worth doing - a new business, a new home, an exciting trip - means accepting the chance it goes wrong. Insurance is what lets us take those chances anyway, and the claim is the moment it either delivers on that promise or fails to.

We're rebuilding that moment. ClaimSorted is an AI-native claims solution for insurers and large corporates that resolves claims faster, fairer, and more reliably than the industry ever has. Handle risk that well, and people are free to take on more of it - that's how you push society toward opportunity: not by eliminating risk, but by making recovery so fast and certain it stops being a reason to hold back.

We're one of the fastest-growing InsurTechs - scaling 10x YoY, processing hundreds of millions in claims payouts, and backed by the world's leading investors: Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo.


What we are looking for

We are looking for a confident, analytical and detail-focused QA & Authorisation Handler to join our Technical Claims Support Team.

You will provide a key technical control across our claims operation, completing Quality Assurance reviews and reviewing claim settlements at the authorisation stage.

As the final line of defence before a claim settlement is approved, you will be responsible for independently reviewing the claim, evidence, policy coverage and settlement calculation before making the decision to authorise, pass back or escalate.

This requires confidence and strong technical judgement. You must be comfortable making decisions, challenging claim assessments where something does not look right and clearly explaining the reasoning behind your decision.

The role goes beyond identifying individual errors. You will use findings from QA and authorisations to identify potential financial leakage, recurring handling issues, process and control gaps and emerging trends across the claims operation.

You will be comfortable using data to understand where issues are occurring, identify root causes and turn findings into practical improvements to processes, controls, guidance and training.

As ClaimSorted works across a range of insurance products and partners, you will need to be adaptable and confident moving between different products, policy wordings, processes and priorities while maintaining consistently high standards.

As part of the wider Technical Claims Support Team, you will also support other technical claims activities where required.

Responsibilities

About EDITED

EDITED is the world’s leading AI-driven retail intelligence platform. We empower the world’s most successful brands and retailers with real-time decision making power. 

By connecting internal business and external market data, EDITED infuses intelligence into every retail decision. We help retailers increase margins, generate more sales, and drive better business outcomes through AI-powered market and enterprise intelligence that fuels automation.

Reporting to the CRO and operating across the full revenue organisation, this is an individual contributor role: you set the play and you run it. title: Group Product Manager
description:
Join a winning Team

EngagedMD is a Patient Journey Management solution for specialty care that helps practices improve patient experience, reduce administrative burden, and convert more patients to care, faster.

We embrace a mission-driven culture where committed individuals come together to make a real impact in healthcare. Join us today in our mission to help carers carry on caring.

You are an innovative and driven product leader looking to chart a path forward for a suite of healthtech products. We’re EngagedMD, a Patient Journey Management solution used nationwide and internationally by over 3 million users since its launch and continues to see enormous growth and adoption from medical clinics across multiple markets. This is an exciting opportunity to join a small and growing team, and to be both strategic and hands-on. You will have the opportunity to set, share, and gain buy-in for the vision for our products, while also closely collaborating with our engineering, sales, customer success, marketing, finance and operations teams. As part of this role, you will be actively leveraging AI on a daily basis to drive roadmap investment decisions and feature direction. 

You’ll also have the opportunity to lead and grow a product team. You’ll be responsible for finding and executing on opportunities to grow and enhance our suite of products. You’ll collaborate with other leaders to manage the software release process while influencing both on-shore and off-shore engineering teams to pursue best-in-class customer experiences for the medical professionals and patients that use our system.  

This fully remote role reports to our VP, Product, and candidates are required to reside in the United States. This role requires legal authorization to work in the United States. EngagedMD is unable to sponsor current H1B visa holders for this role.

title: People Operations Specialist
description:
About Vibe

Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.


Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. title: Creative Strategist (m/w/d) - Vollzeit, vor Ort in Lingen
description:
Du schaust auf einen Ad Account und siehst nach zwei Minuten, wo es hakt? Welcher Angle als Nächstes dran ist, welche Hook fehlt, warum der Winner gerade abbaut?

Dann lies weiter.

Wer wir sind

Commerce Ventures ist die führende Performance-Marketing-Agentur, im Food, Health und Beverage Bereich. Wir betreuen ausschließlich Brands, hinter denen wir stehen, von Gründern und Gründerinnen, die ambitioniert sind und wirklich coole Produkte entwickelt haben.

Monatlich laufen sechsstellige Meta-Budgets über unsere Accounts, und wir haben mehr als eine Brand von null auf achtstellig begleitet.

Der Hebel dahinter ist immer das Creative. Dafür haben wir ein Modell gebaut, das funktioniert: klare Prozesse, klare Zahlen, klare Verantwortung, und Leute, die liefern. Kein Agentur-Bullshit, keine 40-seitigen Decks.

Was du machst

Du übernimmst deine eigenen Brands, in kompletter Eigenverantwortung, drei bis vier Brands maximal, damit du dich voll und ganz auf die Ergebnisse unserer Kunden konzentrieren kannst.

Du übernimmst die komplette Creative Strategy, Media Buying, Kunden-Calls, Planung. Du briefst unsere Post-Production, du entscheidest, was live geht, du weißt jeden Morgen, was die Zahlen sagen und was heute zu tun ist.

Damit wir uns nicht falsch verstehen: Wir suchen keinen Strategen, der Konzepte präsentiert und andere machen lässt. Du setzt die Strategie und lieferst selbst: Angles, Hooks, Skripte, Briefings, Statics. Wer lieber Slides baut und mehr redet als macht, ist bei uns falsch.

Wie wir arbeiten

Wir sind ein kleines Team, remote aufgestellt, und trotzdem haben wir gerade unser Büro in Lingen vergrößert. Warum? Weil die Lernkurve neben Gründer und Team im Office steiler ist als in jedem Google-Meet. Wer die Rolle vor Ort macht, lernt es von denen, die es jeden Tag machen! Und bekommt JUUZ und Prepmymeal Meals im Kühlschrank obendrauf.

Heißt aber nicht, dass remote nicht geht. Wenn du gut bist und selbstständig arbeitest können wir reden. Lingen ist unser Wunsch, aber nicht die Bedingung.

Was bei uns gilt: Wir arbeiten hart, weil gemeinsam Ziele erreichen, Spaß macht!

Wir sagen uns direkt, was Sache ist. Und wir feiern, wenn ein Kunde den Umsatz verdoppelt.

Kurz, unser Motto: doing cool shit with cool people!

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Creative- und Funnel-Strategie für deine Accounts: von der Analyse über den Testplan bis zum fertigen Creative.
  • Du analysierst die Ad Accounts, findest die Lücken (fehlende Angles, , schwache Hooks, schwache Landingpages) und leitest daraus konkrete Testpläne ab.
  • Du entscheidest, was als Nächstes launcht, und priorisierst nach Wirkunk und nicht nach Bauchgefühl.
  • Du schreibst Hooks, Skripte und Ad Copy selbst und baust Statics und Animations, wenn der Account sie braucht.

title: Linux-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) | Hybrid in Freiburg🌄
description:
Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. 

Deine Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt.  

  • Spannende Zukunftsprojekte: Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server.  

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiheit bei technischen Lösungen.  

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Nutze flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit und arbeite in der Regel einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice. Individuell kann nach Absprache auch mehr Remote Arbeit möglich sein. 

  • 30 Urlaubstage: Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und individuellen Lösungen, wenn du darüber hinaus einmal eine längere Auszeit benötigst.  

  • Bonus: Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt erhältst du

title: Partner Manager
description:
Your turn to start the conversation.

Write the future at Rasa.

Conversation. It’s the thread between our product and our people. The tool that enables us to forge relationships through compassion and expertise. To find the connection between our differences. It keeps us close together across borders and backgrounds and helps us create our shared vision.

Rasa means tight-knit. We get to the point and have the courage to ask ‘why?’. Because through relentless experimentation, passion, and vision, we’re transforming the way people interact with organizations through AI.

That’s Rasa. That’s our message.

Join us and add yours.

SUMMARY

We’re looking for a Partner Manager to join our Go-to-Market team. The person’s charter will be to expand our alliances and partner program, demonstrating clear revenue influence (pipeline created through the channel) and strong influence in closed business (i.e. through directly selling through the channel or having a partner source/or strongly influence our closed deal.) You will be reporting to the Director of Partnerships.

Full-time - 100% remote - Location: UK, Germany

  • Rasa can assist with work authorization (visa sponsorship) for candidates located in Germany only.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

As a Partner Manager at Rasa, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating adoption of the developer platform for enterprise AI agents. You will be the strategic centre of our partner ecosystem, moving beyond traditional channel management to build high-trust, revenue-generating alliances with leading System Integrators, digital consulting firms and technology partners.

You will act as the "connective tissue" between our partners and Rasa's internal teams. This means collaborating closely with Sales to co-sell and close complex enterprise deals, working with Marketing to drive joint thought leadership, and liaising with Product to ensure partner feedback shapes our open framework. Success in this role means not just hitting revenue targets, but cultivating a thriving community of experts who trust Rasa as the standard for building enterprise AI agents.

Aufgaben

Virale Short-Form-Videos analysieren, verstehen warum sie funktioniert haben, und das für unsere Creator adaptieren.

Scripts und Shot Lists schreiben, die deine Creator dann aufnehmen. Ihnen präzises Feedback geben, was gut war, was nicht, was sich ändern muss.

Editoren und Poster steuern. Du besitzt das Ergebnis, sie führen aus.

Jeden Post analysieren: warum hat das eingeschlagen, warum ist das gefloppt, worauf setzen wir diese Woche.

Mutige Ideen schnell testen, wegwerfen was nicht funktioniert, skalieren was funktioniert.

Qualifikation

Das ist kein 9-to-5. Wenn Sonntagabend ein Reel viral geht, bist du dran. Wenn unter der Woche um 22 Uhr ein Account gesperrt wird, kümmerst du dich. Das Wochenende ist normalerweise frei, aber bei Emergencies springst du ein, ohne Diskussion. Wenn dich das abschreckt, ist der Job nichts für dich.

Was wir wollen:

Besessenheit von Short-Form. Du schaust täglich stundenlang freiwillig TikTok und Reels und kannst erklären, warum ein Video funktioniert. Du lernst das nicht erst, du lebst es schon.

Ownership-Mentalität. Du behandelst die Accounts deiner Creator wie dein eigenes Business. Keine Ausreden, kein "der Editor hat nicht geliefert", du machst es möglich.

Analytischer Blick. Du kannst dir 20 Videos anschauen und uns sagen, welches Muster die erfolgreichen verbindet.

Fließend Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Nicht verhandelbar.

Bonus, kein Muss: Erfahrung im Aufbau von IG- oder TikTok-Accounts, Agentur- oder Marketing-Hintergrund. Uns zählt Drive und Gespür mehr als dein Lebenslauf.

2.500 EUR Grundgehalt + leistungsbasierte Boni. Realistisch 3.000-6.000 EUR/Monat, je nach Ergebnissen.

100% remote. Arbeite von wo du willst.

Direkter Einfluss. Kleines Team, keine Bürokratie. Deine Ideen gehen diese Woche live, nicht nächstes Quartal.

Klarer Aufstieg. Wer wirklich pusht, kann in 8-12 Monaten Head of Marketing werden und ein eigenes Team führen.

title: Sr. Sustainability Consultant - Fokus PCF/LCA @ Climate Tech Start-up (m/w/d) - 100% Remote möglich

Dann unterstütze mit uns große Unternehmen dabei ihre Emissionen schneller zu reduzieren.

  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit

  • Arbeitsaufgaben, die dich herausfordern und wachsen lassen
  • Umfeld mit viel Freiheit und Raum für Ideen und persönliche Weiterentwicklung

title: Senior National Account Manager
description:
The Practical Detail
Location: Hybrid | Remote

Why this role matters
In your first year, you will deliver an ambitious growth plan for Flora Food Group's largest customer, Bidfood, driving both sales and margin across the full P&L. This role is critical to strengthening Flora's position in the food service market by embedding a joint business plan that aligns Flora's brand priorities with Bidfood's commercial strategy. You will shape how our brands are listed, promoted, and grow within a key account that influences menus and food trends across the UK. Your work will directly impact the availability and innovation of better food in kitchens nationwide.

What you'll do

  • Own the Bidfood P&L, managing pricing, promotions, trade spend, and trade promotion management accruals to achieve sales and margin growth.
  • Lead the joint business plan and negotiate annual trading terms to ensure Flora's brands are well positioned and invested in.
  • Build and maintain relationships across all levels of Bidfood, from senior buyers to depot and logistics teams, to improve service and unlock commercial opportunities.
  • Deliver new product development and innovation launches on time and at the right price, collaborating closely with culinary and new business teams.
  • Champion the push-pull strategy by engaging Bidfood's end users—contract caterers, pubs, hotels, restaurants and Quick Serve Restaurants (QSR) — to grow brand presence and volume.

Performance
You will own the full P&L for the Bidfood account, driving measurable growth in sales and margin while managing trade spend within budget. Your leadership of the joint business plan will ensure alignment between Flora's brand ambitions and Bidfood's commercial goals. Success will be seen in improved brand listings, timely innovation launches, and strong trading terms that support sustainable growth.

Care
You will report directly to Helen Scott and collaborate with internal teams including new business, culinary, supply chain, and demand planning to ensure seamless service delivery. Externally, you will engage with multiple Bidfood functions such as buying, logistics, marketing, and category teams. Your decisions will balance commercial ambition with operational integrity, supporting a lean team environment during a period of organisational change.

Passion
Bidfood is at the heart of food service trends, where culinary culture is shaped. You will connect Flora's innovation pipeline directly to the chefs and kitchens that bring our products to life. Your role will influence how plant-based, indulgent, and culinary food categories evolve in the out-of-home market. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, and functionality will drive meaning

description:
We are seeking radiologists with a chest/thoracic background to carry out structural annotation on de-identified chest CT scans, with a focus on spatial accuracy and consistency against detailed annotation guidelines.

You will work asynchronously on a dedicated annotation platform, marking points, boxes and measurements on findings that have already been flagged upstream, to support the development of clinical AI imaging models.

This is a remote, flexible and short-term project.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Click-point placement: Mark specific coordinates on a scan, such as the centre of a nodule.

  • Bounding boxes: Draw boxes around defined regions of interest, such as a flagged lesion.

  • Simple measurements: Record diameter, or distance between two marked points, on segmentations or polygons already drawn.

  • Guideline application: Work to an annotation guideline covering placement conventions, boundary definitions and measurement rules, applied consistently across a large volume of studies.

  • Edge case handling: Flag ambiguous cases with a short rationale so guidance can be refined.

This is structural markup project with no interpretation required. You will not be reading scans for diagnosis, judging malignancy, or making clinical decisions.


Qualifications:

  • Registration: Registered radiologist in your country of practice with active license

  • Experience: 3–10 years' experience in radiology, with a chest/thoracic focus

  • Knowledge: Strong grounding in thoracic anatomy and cross-sectional CT.

  • Technical proficiency: Comfortable using structured annotation tools and digital platforms.

  • Prior imaging annotation experience is an advantage but not required.

  • Language: Native or near-native written English.


Legal Status:

  • You will have the right to work in your country of residence.

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.

This is a slightly unusual brief, because we're looking for a very particular combination of experience.

First and foremost, you need to be an experienced, hands-on People Operations person. But you also need to have previously worked as an accountant, or have substantial professional accountancy experience.

We want someone who's genuinely curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.

You'll inherit a strong foundation. Over the last three years we've streamlined manual processes, invested in our People technology and changed the way our People function operates. There's plenty we're proud of - but we're definitely not done!

You'll own our People operations, systems and data infrastructure across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle, making sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for opportunities to simplify, automate and improve them.

title: AI and Computer Vision Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

We want you as a hands-on AI and Computer Vision Engineer to build the perception capability behind autonomous close-proximity operations: models that estimate the relative position and orientation of non-cooperative spacecraft from camera images, trained largely on synthetic and lab data, and optimized to run on the compute we can actually fly.

This is a builder role. You write the training code, run the experiments, take the models onto embedded and neuromorphic hardware, and own the results.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as AI and Computer Vision Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • Designing, training and evaluating deep-learning models for 6-DoF pose estimation of non-cooperative spacecraft

  • Owning the full training pipeline: dataset generation and management, augmentation, domain adaptation between synthetic, laboratory and orbital imagery, experiment tracking and reproducibility.

  • Optimizing models for flight-representative compute (knowledge distillation, pruning, quantization and quantization-aware training) and benchmarking latency, memory and power against onboard constraints.

  • Porting and evaluating models on embedded and neuromorphic hardware, and characterizing the accuracy versus energy trade-off.

  • Building explainability and uncertainty into the pipeline so failure modes such as high occlusion can be debugged and the technology is a credible candidate for certification.

  • Exploring privacy-preserving and distributed training approaches that let us improve models with partners without exchanging raw data.

  • Prototyping lightweight self-supervised refinement methods for later in-flight model adaptation on unlabeled imagery.

  • Defining requirements, test scenarios and validation criteria together with GNC/FPO, and supporting the selection and characterization of space-qualified camera sensors.

  • Running validation campaigns on hardware-in-the-loop testbeds and analyzing the results.

  • Managing our training compute footprint across cloud GPU and internal HPC efficiently.

title: Senior Financial Accountant - FTC 12 months
description:
Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

 

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the role.

The Senior Financial Accountant is responsible for key areas of Zilch’s month-end close, financial reporting and operational expenditure accounting. The role operates with a high degree of independence, ensuring financial information is accurate, complete and delivered in line with reporting deadlines and control requirements.

The role requires the individual to resolve complex accounting and operational issues, determine appropriate approaches to new or ambiguous assignments, and identify improvements to Finance processes, systems and controls. The Senior Financial Accountant works closely with colleagues across Finance and the wider business, contributes to cross-functional initiatives and supports the development of junior team members.

Day-to-day responsibilities.

  • Own relevant areas of the monthly management accounts across the P&L and balance sheet, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.

  • Take end-to-end responsibility for operational expenditure accounting and the accruals process, ensuring costs are complete, accurate and appropriately recognised.

  • Partner with FP&A on operational expenditure, explaining performance against budget, investigating variances and providing meaningful commentary and insight.

  • Own specified non-Opex accounting areas, including IFRS 16 lease accounting, advertising revenue and customer acquisition costs.

  • Work with Sales, Growth and other stakeholders to obtain the information required for accurate accounting and determine the appropriate accounting treatment.

  • Own the Finance relationship for Zilch’s Polish subsidiary, working with the local Finance team and external accountants to review the monthly trial balance and supporting reconciliations.

  • Resolve subsidiary accounting queries and oversee management and statutory reporting activities to support accurate and timely consolidation into Group reporting.

title: AIT MGSE Engineer - Lunar Lander
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.


As part of this initiative, we are developing a lunar lander capable of precision landing and reusable operations. To support this effort, we are establishing a dedicated remote test site in the United Arab Emirates to perform hot-fire propulsion testing and hopper flight demonstrations.

We want you as a talented AIT MGSE Engineer to help us in our mission by designing and delivering the MGSEs needed for the preparation and testing of our Lunar Lander.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as AIT MGSE Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day duties will include:

  • Work closely with Engineering and AIT colleagues to understand and refine the requirements/timelines for the different MGSEs that we will need for various assembly or testing activities.

  • Conceptualise, design (CAD including manufacturing drawings), procure and commission the MGSEs.

  • Confirm with mechanical analysis/hand calculations/proof tests that the design is compatible with the external loads.

  • Discuss with suppliers the MGSE designs for ease of manufacturing and with the most adequate processes.

  • Follow up the manufacturing/procurement with the suppliers (with the support of our supply chain team) and answer any technical questions/concerns ensuring timely delivery of all items.

  • Provide necessary instructions and support the assembly / commissioning / implementation of these MGSEs.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of AIT MGSE Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Mechanical / Aerospace engineering degree or similar with focus on machine / structural design.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in CAD design + drafting (using Siemens NX or similar) and FE analysis (using Hypermesh or similar).

  • Good understanding of machine design and different manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, etc), design for manufacturing and GD&T.

  • Familiarity with standard margin calculation methodologies for various applications like beam design, bolted joints, welds, etc.

  • Experience with planning/execution of mechanical tests

Dich begeistern Creatives, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern skalieren? Du willst von grafischer Seite unmittelbar daran mitwirken, dass ein Onlineshop wächst – und in den Zahlen sehen, was dein Hook, dein Static, dein Banner bewegt? Dann bist du bei NEOLYMP richtig. Wir skalieren unseren Shop, und ein großer Teil davon entscheidet sich im Creative. Genau da sitzt du: als Creative Designer:in, der oder die aus Design- und Grafiksicht maßgeblich an unserer Performance mitwirkt.

Wer wir sind

NEOLYMP ist eine Berliner Fitnessmarke, gegründet 2018. Wir entwickeln innovatives Fitnessequipment und ganzheitliche Trainingskonzepte für zu Hause – vom durchdachten Home-Gym-Equipment bis hin zu Online-Kursen, die Training, Motivation und Alltag zusammenbringen. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir über Amazon und unseren eigenen Onlineshop.

Content ist bei uns der Motor: Wir bauen unsere Inhouse-Creative-Produktion konsequent aus – mit echten Shootings, einem Creator-Netzwerk und KI-gestützten Workflows. Unser Grafikteam wächst, und wir suchen jemanden, der das gesamte visuelle Spektrum abdeckt.

Warum diese Rolle

  • Du bist Teil der Performance: Deine Creatives laufen im Paid-Marketing und entscheiden mit, wie profitabel wir skalieren. Du siehst in den Zahlen, welcher Hook funktioniert, welches Static klickt – und drehst mit jeder Iteration an einem Hebel, der direkt auf Umsatz wirkt.
  • Alles aus einer Hand: Video-Creatives, Statics, Social-Content, Shop-Banner, Produktbilder – du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für alles Visuelle und siehst deine Arbeit überall: in Ads, im Feed, im Shop.
  • Bestes Rohmaterial: Du arbeitest mit Content aus echten Shootings und von echten Creatorn – kein Stockmaterial, sondern Persönlichkeiten und Produkte, die du in Szene setzt.
  • Grafikteam statt Einzelkämpfer: Du arbeitest mit Kolleg:innen, die Grafik, Content und Creator verantworten, und eng mit Marketing und Performance zusammen.
  • KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Ersatz: Du nutzt KI-Tools, um schneller zu Varianten und Ideen zu kommen – und entscheidest als Designer:in, was davon gut ist.

Aufgaben

Performance Creatives

  • Du schneidest Video-Creatives für Meta, TikTok und weitere Paid-Kanäle – vom Rohmaterial aus Shootings und Creator-Content bis zum fertigen Ad, inklusive Hook-Varianten, Untertiteln und Sound.
  • Du gestaltest Static Ads, die in Sekunden verstanden werden, und entwickelst sie auf Basis der Performance-Daten iterativ weiter.
  • Du setzt Briefings aus dem Performance-Team um und bringst eigene Ideen für Formate, Hooks und Varianten ein.

Social Media & Organic Content

  • Du produzierst Grafiken, Reels-Schnitte, Story-Formate und Carousels für unsere organischen Kanäle – konsistent im Look, an

title: Support Coordinators
description:
About the role

We're looking for two Payment Support Coordinators to join our Expert Services & Operations (ES&O) team on a short-term contract basis. You'll work directly on our linguist payment queue, helping to clear a backlog of payment requests and restoring a reliable, responsive experience for our global network of expert linguists.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role. You'll be triaging, investigating, and resolving payment issues across multiple systems, working closely with our existing coordinators and escalating to finance and engineering where needed.

What you'll be doing

  • Triaging and responding to incoming payment support tickets in Jira, prioritising by urgency and issue type

  • Investigating payment failures, discrepancies, and delays across the Lilt platform, Tipalti, Salesforce, and third-party processors (PayPal, Payoneer)

  • Resolving common issues including: Tipalti profile corrections, 2FA resets, banking detail mismatches, and manual offline payment (OPM) re-logging

  • Communicating clearly and empathetically with linguists to gather information and provide timely updates

  • Escalating technical breakages (e.g. platform stats sync issues) and rate discrepancies to the relevant internal teams

  • Maintaining accurate ticket notes and contributing to weekly reporting on queue volume and SLA adherence

What we're looking for

  • Experience in a payments, finance operations, or customer/vendor support role

  • Comfortable working across multiple systems simultaneously (Jira, Salesforce, or similar)

  • Detail-oriented with strong written communication skills — you'll be dealing with complex, sometimes sensitive payment disputes

  • Able to work independently, manage a high-volume queue, and know when to escalate

  • Experience with Tipalti or international payment platforms is a strong plus

  • Fluency in English required; additional languages are a bonus given our global linguist community

What to expect

This is a contract role. You'll be joining a small, collaborative ES&O team and will have clear ownership of a defined portion of the queue from day one.

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

title: Founding Account Executive, New Business
description:
About Fyxer

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.


What we're looking for

  • 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months, and quota hit in two of your last three measured periods

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

  • You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

How we work

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product.

We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.


The Fyxer Reality: Why We Win

  • The Trajectory: We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32.

  • The Evidence: Ranked 7th in Andreessen Horowitz’s list of top AI apps. Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We are the outlier.

  • The Culture of Agency: We hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.

  • Zero Bureaucracy: No slow-motion decision-making

title: Business Unit Leiter Banking (w/m/d)
description:
Über cognitivo

Die cognitivo AG ist eine spezialisierte Unternehmensberatung für Software und Analytics mit Hauptsitz in Karlsruhe. Seit 2013 begleiten wir Banken, Versicherungen und Zahlungsdienstleister entlang ihrer gesamten Wertschöpfungskette – von der Strategie bis zur Abnahme. Unser Leitsatz: „Big enough to deliver and small enough to care.“

Gestalte die Zukunft unserer Business Unit Banking

Als Leiter Business Unit Banking übernimmst du die unternehmerische Gesamtverantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Business Unit und gestaltest damit maßgeblich ihre Zukunft. Du verbindest strategisches Denken, Führungsstärke und vertriebliche Verantwortung mit einem tiefen Verständnis für die Anforderungen des Banking- und Payment-Marktes. Gemeinsam mit einem engagierten Team entwickelst du unsere Kundenbeziehungen weiter, erschließt neue Geschäftsfelder und sorgst dafür, dass aus Marktchancen nachhaltiges Wachstum entsteht. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Kunden auf Management-Ebene zusammen und behältst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung der Business Unit stets im Blick.

Aufgaben

About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

title: Senior Producer
description:
Senior Producer

ScapeWorld Entertainment

Remote. Our working day runs on CET, wherever you sit. Full time, on a long-term contract. Starting as soon as you can. Where you live while you do is up to you; the location field on this posting only fits one country, so please read this as the real rule and apply from wherever you are.

About us

We are Scape, a Swedish game studio of about 30 people, fully remote by choice. We are launching Scape on Steam Early Access later this year: a growing platform of multiplayer games where a player's identity carries across all of them. The first game inside Scape is Gravity: a precision climbing game where 100 players share one server, one tower, and one long way down. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios, Epic and Ubisoft.

Since we are a small team about to put our first game in front of players, we are looking for the person who holds the plan, the priorities and the team together while we do it. If that sounds like you, we would love to meet.

The role

Let us start with the studio you would be joining. Around thirty people, fully remote, and a group of strong leads in design, art, engineering, QA, community and commercial who own their crafts and run their own teams. What we do not have is the person who looks across all of them at once, holds the plan they are all working to, and makes the day-to-day calls that keep it moving as one. That is this role. It is the only production seat in the company, and it comes with real authority.

You would work closely with the Creative Director. They own what the game is, set the direction and make the big bets. You own the plan that gets us there and the decisions inside it: scope, sequencing and trade-offs within a milestone are yours to make, and you decide which questions need to reach them and which do not. They should be able to step back and know that things are being handled, because they are.

In practice, it comes down to four things:

You know how a game gets made. You can see what depends on what, where the effort really sits, and whether an estimate is going to hold. When a lead tells you how long something takes, you know how to hear it and what has to land for the work to ship on time.

You own the plan and the priorities. Not just the schedule, but the order of work behind it. When two things compete, you decide, or you get the decision made and tell everyone affected. Open questions have an owner and a date. Nothing sits unanswered because nobody was sure whose call it was.

title: Senior Counsel, Strategic Partnerships
Senior Asset Pipeline Engineer, Sim-Ready Content
description:
About Genesis AI

Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world.

About the Role

A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem.

We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out.

The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't.

Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. You'll be building that as a first-class part of the pipeline rather than bolting it on.

You'll work closely with the stakeholders, who set direction and priorities. You own the technical design and the implementation and you're expected to bring enough pipeline experience to challenge the plan where it needs challenging.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain the end-to-end asset pipeline, from ingestion through to validated output

  • Design agent-driven nodes that generate input content and make decisions inside the graph, with the structured outputs, guardrails and fallbacks that make them dependable in batch

  • Develop automated processing stages: mesh repair, retopology, decimation and LODs, UV unwrapping and texel density normalization, collision proxy generation
